# 05 — Standalone web codegen (shadcn / Tailwind v4)

Input: IR files. Output: `dist/web/<web.componentDir>/<kebab-name>.tsx` per component. Output has **no Loom runtime dependency**; it needs `react`, `class-variance-authority`, `lucide-react` (only if an Icon is used), and `cn` from `web.cnImport`.

## Header

```
// @generated by loom — do not edit. source: <IR.source> hash: <IR.hash> id: <IR.id>
```

## Algorithm

1. For each IR node, compute **style props** (list in 03) and **content props**.
2. For each style prop expression, take `paramsOfExpr`. Filter to closed params (enum/boolean). Lint already guaranteed ≤1 closed param per style prop and no open params (LOOM205/207).
3. **Static** (no params): evaluate with empty env → classes go in the node's base class string.
4. **Variant-dependent** (one closed param `P`): for every value `v` in `domainOf(P)`, evaluate → classes under `variants.P.v` of that node's `cva`. Boolean params use keys `true`/`false` (CVA supports boolean variant keys).
5. A node with ≥1 variant-dependent class gets its own `cva(...)`; node without stays a literal string. `defaultVariants` come from param defaults (omit if none; a required enum with no default → no default entry).
6. Content props → JSX attributes/children directly (params become variables; `cond` → ternary; `lookup` → object-literal index; `String(x)` → `String(x)`).
7. `when` → `{cond && <El/>}`; `repeat` → `{xs.map((x) => (<El key={…}/>))}`.
8. Evaluate a prop once per domain value; **throw LOOM301 if a class mapping is missing** (never emit unknown classes).

CVA names: root node → `<camelName>Variants`; other nodes → `<camelName>N<path-with-underscores>Variants` (e.g. `buttonN0_1Variants`). Only emitted when needed.

## Element mapping

| Primitive | Element | Base classes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HStack | `div` | `flex flex-row` |
| VStack | `div` | `flex flex-col` |
| ZStack | `div` | `relative grid *:col-start-1 *:row-start-1` + alignment |
| Spacer | `div` | `flex-1` (+ `min-w-N min-h-N` if `min`) |
| Divider | `div role="separator"` | h: `h-px self-stretch shrink-0 bg-border`; v: `w-px self-stretch shrink-0 bg-border` |
| Text | `span` | typography classes |
| Image | `img` | `object-*` + sizing + `rounded-*`, `alt={label ?? ""}` |
| Icon | lucide component from `icons` map | `size-N`, `text-<color>` |
| Pressable | `button type="button"` | `flex` (+ `flex-col` if vertical) `cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90 active:opacity-80 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-default focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring` |

Root element accepts `className` merged with `cn(…)`, plus `ref`-less simple function components (no forwardRef). Props type = `<Name>Props & { className?: string }`; `action` → `() => void`, `icon` → `string`, `child` → LOOM301 (deferred).

## Class tables (data in `packages/compiler/src/gen-web/maps.ts`; closed sets only)

| Input | Class |
| --- | --- |
| `gap={k}` | `gap-<k>` if `spacing[k] == 4k`, else `gap-[<px>px]` |
| `padding` number | `p-<k>`; `[v,h]` → `py-<v> px-<h>`; object → `pt- pr- pb- pl-` (omit missing) |
| `align` | start `items-start` · center `items-center` · end `items-end` · stretch `items-stretch` |
| `justify` | start `justify-start` · center `justify-center` · end `justify-end` · spaceBetween `justify-between` |
| ZStack `alignment` | `place-items-*`: topStart `place-items-start justify-items-start`… (9 entries; table in code) |
| `width`/`height` number n | `w-<n/4>` / `h-<n/4>` if n%4==0 else `w-[<n>px]` |
| `width` `"N%"` | `w-[N%]` |
| `hugging` | `w-fit` / `h-fit` |
| `fill` | by **parent** element axis: row parent → `flex-1 min-w-0` (width) / `self-stretch` (height); column parent → `self-stretch` (width) / `flex-1 min-h-0` (height); else `w-full`/`h-full` |
| `cornerRadius` | `rounded-<name>` (`full` → `rounded-full`) |
| `clip` | `overflow-hidden` |
| `background` | `bg-<c>`; `color` → `text-<c>`; `<c>` from the color table below |
| `typography` | table below |
| `lines={n}` | `line-clamp-<n>` |
| `align` (Text) | `text-left` / `text-center` / `text-right` |
| `resizeMode` | `object-cover` / `object-contain` / `object-fill` |
| Icon `size` n | `size-<n/4>` or `size-[<n>px]` |

**Color table:** surface→`background`, surfaceRaised→`secondary`, textPrimary→`foreground`, textMuted→`muted-foreground`, separator→`border`, accent→`primary`, accentSoft→`accent`, onAccent→`primary-foreground`, danger→`destructive`, onDanger→`destructive-foreground`, transparent→`transparent`. (`surfaceRaised` → `secondary`; if used as a card the same value is also `--card`.) Any role not listed → `loom-<kebab>`.

**Typography table (approximate to Tailwind sizes; documented lossy):** display `text-4xl font-bold` · title `text-2xl font-semibold` · title2 `text-xl font-semibold` · headline `text-base font-semibold` · body `text-base` · callout `text-sm` · caption `text-xs` · caption2 `text-[11px] leading-[13px]`.

## Normative example — Badge

Class *sets* are normative; whitespace/ordering of class tokens within a string is sorted alphabetically for determinism.

```tsx
// @generated by loom — do not edit. source: components/Badge/Badge.loom.tsx hash: <hash> id: cmp_badge
import { cva } from "class-variance-authority"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const badgeVariants = cva("grid h-5 place-items-center relative rounded-full w-5 *:col-start-1 *:row-start-1", {
  variants: { tone: { accent: "bg-primary", danger: "bg-destructive" } },
  defaultVariants: { tone: "danger" },
})
const badgeN0_0Variants = cva("text-[11px] leading-[13px]", {
  variants: { tone: { accent: "text-primary-foreground", danger: "text-destructive-foreground" } },
  defaultVariants: { tone: "danger" },
})

export interface BadgeProps { count: number; tone?: "accent" | "danger" }

export function Badge({ count, tone = "danger", className }: BadgeProps & { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className={cn(badgeVariants({ tone }), className)}>
      <span className={badgeN0_0Variants({ tone })}>{count > 99 ? "99+" : String(count)}</span>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Drift check

`loom gen web --check`: generate into memory, compare every file byte-for-byte with disk, also fail if disk contains a `@generated` file with no IR source. Message: `LOOM320 <path> is out of date; run loom gen web`.

## Codegen diagnostics

`LOOM301` unsupported (child param; missing class mapping) · `LOOM320` drift.

## Deferred (do not build)

`bindTo:` wrapping existing shadcn components; compound variants; zero-runtime JSX transform; forwardRef.
